# Mouser v3.7.3.2

This macOS-focused fork release adds native Smart Zoom and fixes screenshot actions for customized system shortcuts.

## Smart Zoom on macOS

Smart Zoom is now available in the action picker on macOS. Assign it to the Gesture button or any other programmable control to send the same native `SmartMagnify` event used by a Magic Mouse double tap. Supported apps, including web browsers and PDF viewers, decide how to zoom around the pointer and toggle back out.

The new action is localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

## Screenshot shortcuts now follow macOS settings

Screenshot actions no longer assume the default `Command-Shift-3/4` shortcuts. Mouser now invokes the corresponding macOS symbolic screenshot action, so region and full-screen captures continue to work when those shortcuts have been customized in System Settings.

Debug event routing is also written to the rotating Mouser log, making future button-mapping problems diagnosable without copying text from the UI.
